|notes=The remastered slip for Bad Feeling Have I uses the official text dated 4 December 2006. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Bad Feeling Have I (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Bad Feeling Have I (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions restrict lightsaber combat and retain the Vader deployment bonus and 2-Force duel search. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=10 period rulebook] uses the remastered wording to illustrate a search for a card with a particular property.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 28. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Bad Feeling Have I]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf first release sheet of 30 May 2003] and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf revised sheet labeled 19 June 2003] (old pre-Remaster slips).
